column1: # tools/isa-payload.tsv -- the population `probe4` probes, one row per encoding.
# THIS IS THE OWNER.  `tools/isapay.py emit` generates the payload's cells and
# its row table from this file; nothing else may declare a probed encoding.
# WHY THIS IS NOT `tools/isa-census.tsv`.  That file is the PRIOR-ART census
# (`R1-pub-0`) and `docs/isa-prior-art.md` § 0 states in its own words that it
# "does not claim ... that the population is the ISA" and that "an instruction
# this core obviously has, and that the loader executes thousands of times per
# boot, gets no row".  The instructions it excludes by that rule are exactly
# pass condition at `:1074`.  So the payload's population is rebuilt from the
# plan's nine groups and then JOINED to the census, in both directions, by
# `isapay.py population`.  A row in one and not the other is a reportable
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; no `|` anywhere -- `spec-check` C8 counts cells by pipe)
#   group    plan group this row belongs to.  `isapay population` checks every
#            plan group has at least one row, so deleting a group is loud.
#   shape    which cell template the generator instantiates.
#   fields   the encoding, as fields.  `isapay encode` builds a word from these.
#   word     the same encoding, as a literal.  WRITTEN BY HAND.  `encode`
#            refuses if the two disagree -- and `isapay verify` disassembles the
#            BUILT ARTEFACT and refuses if binutils decodes it as anything but
#            this row, which is the third and only conceptually independent
#   seed     -> $2 before the probed instruction.  A row whose `expect` equals
#            its `seed` is REFUSED: "wrote the right answer" and "wrote nothing"
#   read     which recorded word `expect` is about: gpr / m0 / m1 / aux.
#   expect   the single computable constant.  `-` for a row with no answer.
#   qemu     PRE-REGISTERED prediction for the qemu leg: run / trap.
#   why      one line.  No tabs, no pipes.
